g.text: Ownership rules (checked by the API, not by
RLS): an itinerary is opened by its owner's
session (owner_id) or by the holder of the
grants a read-only view. Tokens are stored
only as SHA-256 digests. CHECK: owner_id or

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(187, 187, 187), rgb(76, 76, 76));

g.text: PK primary key · FK foreign key · UK unique · bold = key column
NULL = nullable; every other column is NOT NULL
Line ends show cardinality enforced by PostgreSQL constraints
Labels or FK note: composite keys, ON DELETE (default NO ACTION)
Dashed table = shown in full on another page
Session, recovery-code and guest/share tokens are random 256-bit (sessions, links) or 80-bit
(recovery codes) values; only digests are stored. Passwords are scrypt hashes.
